item.title: Whiskers 0.8.57
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.57

### Recording Feedback

  • Improved the recording waveform with smoother, more natural motion so dictation feels more responsive while you speak

    • ### Dictation Reliability

  • Improved audio capture recovery so dictation is less likely to stumble when large audio callbacks arrive or input conditions change
  • Added stronger protection against dropped audio callbacks so recording stays more dependable during longer or busier sessions
